privacy.ai_training_note: CrowdStrike employs Privacy-by-Design principles and uses synthetic data to train AI models rather than customer data. Privacy notice explicitly states: 'This Notice does not apply to the information our customers upload or provide to us when they use our Offerings,' with separate Data Protection Agreement governing customer data handling. Platform includes capabilities to detect and prevent movement of sensitive data to AI training systems (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
privacy.data_region: Multiple geographic regions with data processing agreements and appropriate safeguards; compliant with GDPR adequacy requirements and US-EU/Swiss Data Privacy Frameworks

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Data protected with encryption; specific protocols documented in Data Protection Agreement and security assessments

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Customer Personal Data deleted within 90 days of service deprovisioning unless retention required by law or agreement

security.name: Data Discovery & Classification
security.value: Cloud data classification and visibility without proxies or added infrastructure via eBPF sensors

security.name: Runtime Data Monitoring
security.value: Monitors sensitive data in motion across APIs, cloud services, and applications to detect risky movement and exfiltration in real time

security.name: GenAI Data Protection
security.value: Detects movement of sensitive data to GenAI tools, APIs, and model training (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker) with automated response integration

products.name: Falcon Next-Gen Endpoint Protection (Go, Pro, Enterprise tiers)
products.data_scope: Endpoint telemetry, process execution, network connections, file activity
products.notes: Includes antivirus, device control, mobile protection, firewall management, threat hunting, IT hygiene. SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS v4, HIPAA validated, FedRAMP High certified.

products.name: Falcon Next-Gen SIEM
products.data_scope: Log aggregation from endpoints, cloud, identity, SaaS; correlates cross-domain detections
products.notes: AI-native SIEM engine optimized for speed and automation. Supports compliance reporting (NIST, GDPR, HIPAA). Part of Falcon Platform unified architecture.

products.name: Falcon Next-Gen Identity Security
products.data_scope: Identity events, authentication logs, privilege escalation, SaaS identity, AI agent identity
products.notes: Unified security for human, non-human, AI identities and SaaS. ITDR, PAM, SaaS identity security modules. ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA compliant.

products.name: Falcon Cloud Security
products.data_scope: Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), container/Kubernetes, AI model scanning, data classification, API security
products.notes: Agentless cloud workload protection with AI model scanning and security dashboards. ISO 27017, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS compliant.

products.name: Falcon Complete Next-Gen MDR
products.data_scope: 24/7 expert-led monitoring of endpoint, cloud, identity, and SaaS security events
products.notes: Fully managed service combining Falcon Platform telemetry with human expert analysis. Includes breach prevention warranty. FedRAMP High, SOC 2 Type II.

products.name: Falcon for XIoT & OT Security
products.data_scope: Connected devices, operational technology network traffic, industrial control systems
products.notes: Extended IoT and OT security. FedRAMP High authorized. Serves federal agencies and critical infrastructure.

products.name: Charlotte AI
products.data_scope: Aggregated security telemetry from all Falcon modules for agentic investigation and response
products.notes: Agentic workflow automation for SOC operations. FedRAMP High authorized as of 2026. ISO 42001 (AI governance) certified.
